python.description: Uses classical cryptography. Switch to modern safe parameters or integrate liboqs-python bindings for post-quantum algorithms.
Older versions lack support for post-quantum algorithms and have outdated TLS 1.3 parameter sets.

javascript.description: node-forge does not support post-quantum key exchange or signatures. Use native Node.js webcrypto or pqcrypto bindings.
Lacks support for post-quantum token signing algorithms (ML-DSA).

go.description: Contains deprecated draft versions of Kyber/Dilithium. Upgrade to v1.6.3+ for FIPS 203/204 compliance (ML-KEM/ML-DSA).
Lacks native Go ML-KEM support. Update Go toolchain to 1.24+ and use crypto/mlkem.

rust.description: Lacks post-quantum primitives natively. Pair with pqcrypto-kyber or pqcrypto-dilithium crates.
RustCrypto ml-kem crate is marked as experimental and not-yet-audited. Use pqcrypto-kyber with C bindings for production.

java.description: Lacks FIPS 203/204/205 standard names (ML-KEM, ML-DSA). Upgrade to BouncyCastle 1.78+.
